profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Palo Alto Networks | Backend Engineer | GO | Microservices | Kubernetes | GCP | AWS | AI application | DevOps
profile.summary:
SUMMARY
• More than 10 years of professional experience in software and web application development for enterprise solutions.
• Experienced in microservices architecture, Restful services, and back-end service development, with expertise in containerization
solutions such as Docker, Kubernetes, and container repositories.
• Hands-on experience in Python, Spring Framework, C++, microservices, containerization, DevOps tools, and product building.
• Collaborating with solution architects, project managers, and sales engineers to offer advanced architectures that fulfill business
and customer needs.

With a robust track record at Virsec, my focus extends to architecting and enhancing complex microservices-based systems, boosting performance to accommodate escalating workloads. My proficiency in Java and Python has been pivotal in leading the development of a platform-independent Agent, fostering seamless operations across diverse operating systems.

The solutions I've designed ensure high availability and real-time failover, translating into dependable security tools for our clients. This innovation-driven approach, coupled with my expertise in AWS Cloud and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, underscores our team's commitment to delivering state-of-the-art enterprise solutions.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
• Languages: Python, Java, C++, C#
• Web & Server Technologies: Spring Framework, REST API, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, .Net MVC Razor, HTML5, NGINX proxy
• Server & Cloud Technology: AWS (EKS, ECS, ECR, Fargate, S3, EC2, MSK, RDS, DocumentDB, CI-CD), VMware, Azure Kubernetes, Container Services (ECR, Fargate), Docker, OpenShift, Helm Chart
• Deployment Service: 
• Scripting Languages: Shell Script, Batch Script, PowerShell
• Database: MongoDB, AWS DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server
• Operating System: Linux Distribution (Red Hat, Ubuntu, Alpine), Mac, Windows
• Other: Git, Gitlab, JIRA, Confluence, Agile, Distributed System, Inter-Process-Communication, CI/CD

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a distributed Central Management Console (CPM) using Java, Spring Framework, Redis, Kafka, MongoDB (DocumentDB), and over 27 microservices. This system facilitated SaaS configuration on AWS Cloud and on-premises VMware, improving backend performance and workload handling by 40%.
• Led the development of a platform-independent Agent to handle communication between the SaaS-based Center Management Console and probe software using Python, C++, Multithreading, REST API, Kafka, SaaS, Inter-Process Communication, and mTLS. This common code works on all the OS.
• Designed and implemented various modules to provide easy and fast deployment and instrumentation of the product using a containerization approach with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm Chart, kustomize, Docker, MSI, and shell script-based installation. This saved deployment time from 5 hours to 30 minutes and helped 90% of customers.
• Designed and developed the Centralized Probe Management (CPM) API as a microservice and as a module of the platform to configure, troubleshoot, and monitor probes, and to support the upgrade process using Python, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Redis and Apache Kafka. 
• Transformed the monolithic Web application into microservice and containers to support Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 
• Automated the entire CI/CD pipeline from build to deployment using Gitlab, shell scripts, PowerShell scripts, Python and Git which helped developers to build and test the releases faster. This reduced 3 days of tasks into 4 hours.
• Implemented high availability for CMS services and MongoDB utilizing DRBD, Pacemaker, and recovery script on Linux. 
• Engaged in Agile methodology by actively participating in daily scrum meetings and executing development tasks within bi- weekly sprints, using JIRA and Confluence for streamlined project management.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for the development of a complex Microservices-based Central Management Console using Java, Spring Framework, Redis, Kafka (multi broker), MongoDB (DocumentDB), and more than 35 microservices with features facilitating SaaS configuration on AWS Cloud and on-Premises VMWare. It improved performances and ability to handle workload by 40%.
•	Implemented a high availability for CMS services and MongoDB utilizing DRBD, Pacemaker, and recovery script on Linux. This solution act as a primary-secondary node configuration and seamlessly switches the IP from primary to secondary in real-time upon unavailability. This solution helped 3 customers in keeping their security tools highly available. 
•	Provided advanced architectural solutions to meet the needs of both the business and customers by collaboratively working with project managers and customer success teams which resulted in securing over 20 customer deals.
•	Customized the deployment and installation process seamlessly for the product by developing new modules as per customer environment such as Helm Chart, MSI-WIX, RPM in Bash Script, CI-CD Script for instrumenting agent in container.
•	Engaged in Agile methodology, actively participating in daily scrum meetings and executing development tasks within bi-weekly sprints, utilizing JIRA and Confluence for streamlined project management.

Java, Python, C++
Microservices Spring Boot, REST API, Swagger
Kubernetes, AWS EKS, RedHat Openshift, Docker, Shell Scripts, Batch Scripting, Powershell
Linux Distribution, Windows
AWS Services, Google Cloud, On-Premise VMWare (VCenter + ESXi) RedHat Openshift
MongoDB, PostgreSQL,
Agile Methodology with Scrum Framework - JIRA

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Client DXC TECHNOLOGY 

Former *[ Hewlett Packard Enterprise ]*

•	Engaged in full-stack web and desktop application development utilizing C#, Java, .Net MVC Razor, Spring Boot, REST API, ASP.net, TFS and database technologies such as SQL, ORM, and Angular.
•	Led the project to develop a claim processing application with both web and desktop experiences using C#, Reflection API, OCR API, .Net forms, IBM Content Manager, and an AWS RDS Database. This application processes 20,000 claims daily and is 70% faster than the previous version.
•	Executed seamless deployment and migration of infra to cloud services like Amazon AWS S3, EC2, ECR, CI/CD, RDS and others.
•	Designed and implemented SSO for various web and desktop applications using Active Directory, OpenID Connect, SAML and Web API in Microsoft Azure.
•	Built an Image Scanning application using C#, TWAIN Driver, Barcode API, OCR API, and resulting in a cost saving of $100K.
•	Built X-RAY Scanning Application in C# and Java using TWAIN Driver, Canon Camera SDK which saved $70K in project cost.
•	Created stored procedures, and functions for SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages with the Microsoft SQL Server for business analysts. 
•	Designed workflow for migrating and configured of the IBM content Manager OnDemand Server to migrate and maintain 700 Terabyte of data and images from on-premises to cloud infrastructure in AWS S3 without impacting business.  
•	Practiced agile methodology for various projects by attending in-person daily scrum meetings and bi-weekly sprints.
